name: Apollo 15
intro: Dave Scott here. This time we bring a car: the Lunar Roving Vehicle!
We're aiming for Hadley Rille, a giant winding canyon next to tall mountains.
The other finalist was the Marius Hills. Scientists argued for months!
I'll also drop a hammer and a feather to see which lands first.
briefing: Mountains on both sides, a canyon in front. Tricky approach!
Choose the landing site. Low Sun, remember.
fact: On the Moon, with no air, the hammer and the feather hit the ground at the same time.

site.name: Hadley Rille and the Apennine Mountains
